title: N,P-codoped carbon shells grafted on nickel nanoparticles as an efficient catalyst for hydrogen generation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,657-666
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01281C, Paper
Sarvesh Kumar, Ashwini Anshu, Rajeev Kumar, Ankit Yadav, Balaram Sahoo
A dual heteroatom (N,P)-doped carbon nanostructure grafted on nickel nanoparticles synergistically enhances the catalytic effect for H2O adsorption during the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER).
